newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian O/N rates ease, close at 20.375 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian O/N rates ease, close at 20.375 pct.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed a little lower in balanced trading with good activity on Wednesday, dealers said.
Overnight rates closed at 20.375 percent, against 21 percent at the opening and 21.00/21.125 percent at Tuesday's close.
Dealers said there were no factors to particularly influence the market thus the usual end-of-the-reserve period phenomena of declining rates dominated.
"There was quite a good activity and interest rates were slipping as we approach the end of the reserve period," said Karoly Barath of Postabank. "Trading was quite balanced."
The current two-week reserve period ends on Friday.
